name: Create a new application
description: Create a new application Create a Containers application. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/containers/applications
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/containers/applications
Create a Containers application. Use `scheduling_policy: "default"` for a scheduler-backed application. The Containers scheduler maintains the requested instance count and manages deployment configuration, placement, scaling, versions, and rollouts. Use `scheduling_policy: "durable_object"` for a Durable Object-managed application. Each Durable Object creates and manages the lifecycle of its container instance. Supply `name`, `scheduling_policy`, and `durable_objects`, with optional `configuration` and optional top-level `observability` settings. Deployment configuration, scaling, constraints, versions, and rollouts do not apply.
Required: account_id (path) — Account identifier.; body (body)

name: Create a new rollout for an application
description: Create a new rollout for an application Creates a rollout to update the application's configuration across instances with minimal downtime. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/containers/applications/{application_id}/rollouts
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/containers/applications/{application_id}/rollouts
Creates a rollout to update the application's configuration across instances with minimal downtime. Rollouts apply only to scheduler-backed applications with `scheduling_policy: "default"`. Versions and rollouts do not apply to applications with `scheduling_policy: "durable_object"`.
Required: account_id (path) — Account identifier.; application_id (path); body (body)

name: Configure a private external image registry
description: Configure a private external image registry Registers credentials for a supported private external image registry so Containers can pull images from it. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/containers/registries
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/containers/registries
Registers credentials for a supported private external image registry so Containers can pull images from it. This endpoint does not create a registry or upload an image. Public Docker Hub images and images in the Cloudflare managed registry do not require this configuration. Refer to [Image management](https://developers.cloudflare.com/containers/platform-details/image-management/) for supported registries and instructions for storing registry credentials.
Required: account_id (path) — Account identifier.; body (body)

name: Delete a single application by id
description: Delete a single application by id Deletes a single application by id. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/containers/applications/{application_id}

name: Delete a registry from the account
description: Delete a registry from the account Delete a registry from the account, this will prevent Containers from pulling images from the registry. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/containers/registries/{domain}

name: Generate a JWT to interact with the specified image registry.
description: Generate a JWT to interact with the specified image registry. Generates credentials for accessing a configured container image registry. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/containers/registries/{domain}/credentials
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/containers/registries/{domain}/credentials
Generates credentials for accessing a configured container image registry.
Required: account_id (path) — Account identifier.; domain (path); body (body)

name: Get a single application by id
description: Get a single application by id Returns a single application by id. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/containers/applications/{application_id}

name: Get a container instance
description: Get a container instance Returns a container instance belonging to an application. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/containers/applications/{application_id}/instances/{instance_id}

name: List Applications associated with your account
description: List Applications associated with your account Lists all the applications that are associated with your account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/containers/applications
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/containers/applications
Lists all the applications that are associated with your account.
Required: account_id (path) — Account identifier.
Optional: name (query) — Filter applications by name.; image (query) — Filter applications by image.

name: List all application versions
description: List all application versions Returns all versions for a scheduler-backed application with `scheduling_policy: "default"`. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/containers/applications/{application_id}/versions
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/containers/applications/{application_id}/versions
Returns all versions for a scheduler-backed application with `scheduling_policy: "default"`. Versions and rollouts do not apply to applications with `scheduling_policy: "durable_object"`.
Required: account_id (path) — Account identifier.; application_id (path)

name: List container instances
description: List container instances Lists container instances belonging to an application. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/containers/applications/{application_id}/instances
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/containers/applications/{application_id}/instances
Lists container instances belonging to an application.
Required: account_id (path) — Account identifier.; application_id (path)
Optional: per_page (query) — Maximum number of instances to return per page. Defaults to all.; page_token (query) — Opaque token from a previous response to retrieve the next page.; state (query) — Filters instances by lifecycle state. `active` includes provisioning, running, and stopping instances; `not-active` includes stopped and failed instances. When omitted, all instances are returned.; name_prefix (query) — Filter instances by a case-sensitive name prefix, falling back to the actor ID when no name is known. Keep the same prefix when using a page token.

name: Get the list of configured registries in the account
description: Get the list of configured registries in the account Get the list of configured registries in the account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/containers/registries
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/containers/registries
Get the list of configured registries in the account.
Required: account_id (path) — Account identifier.

name: Modify an application
description: Modify an application Modifies a single application by id. PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/containers/applications/{application_id}

name: Prepare a container image
description: Prepare a container image Idempotently starts or observes preparation of the runtime artifacts required to run one digest-pinned managed container image on Cloudflare's network. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/containers/image-preparations
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/containers/image-preparations
Idempotently starts or observes preparation of the runtime artifacts required to run one digest-pinned managed container image on Cloudflare's network. Returns 202 while durable preparation continues and 200 when the image is ready or preparation has reached a terminal error.
Required: account_id (path) — Account identifier.; body (body)
